standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril.text: If the player has lost their wolfbane dagger:

steps.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.npc: Yes I know, but you have no space for a it at the moment so I can't return it to you.

steps.text: If the player's inventory isn't full:

steps.npc: Yes I know! Luckily for you it washed up on the banks of the Salve earlier! Here, take it again, but please try and be more careful this time. It's a family heirloom after all!

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril.text: If the player has lost their temple library key:

steps.npc: Ok, here's another one for you.

steps.player: Hello again, Drezel. Is there anything that I can help you out with around here?

steps.text: If the player does not meet the requirements for Nature Spirit:

steps.npc: Well... I don't think so. There's not much to do in that place.

steps.text: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Nature Spirit quest.
If the player meets the requirements for Nature Spirit:

steps.npc: Well... there is something you could do for me if you're interested. Though it is quite dangerous.

options.text: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?

steps.player: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?

steps.npc: There's a man called Filliman who lives in Mort Myre. He comes by the temple from time to time but I haven't seen him recently. I was wondering if you could check in on him?
I must warn you, it could be dangerous. Mort Myre is filled with ghasts!

steps.player: Sorry, I don't think I can help.

steps.npc: That's fine, I'm sure someone else will be along shortly who can. Now, if you will excuse me, I do have some things to be getting on with.

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.player: Hi there! Filliman says I've completed the quest!

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.npc: Hello, [player name]. How are things in Morytania?

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.player: Not as well as I'd hope, Drezel. I'm still working with the Myreque. I just hope that we can find a way to defeat those Drakans.

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.npc: You can be sure that a great many people hope for exactly the same thing, [player name]. Good luck to you, and Myreque prevail!

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.player: We've managed to create a new weapon to fight the vampyres with. I used it to kill Ranis Drakan!

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.npc: This is amazing news, [player name]. Myreque prevail!

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.player: As well as they could be, everything considered. We lost everything, Drezel.

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.npc: Not everything. There's still you, me and Ivan. Veliaf is out there somewhere as well. It's not much, but it's something to be thankful for.
Morytania has never been darker. Trust in Saradomin, friend. There is still a chance we will live through this darkness.

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.player: Not too bad, Drezel. How about here?

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.npc: Well, it's nice to not have to worry as much about the vampyres, but I must admit, I'm still not overly comfortable about the fact that we're now all trying to be friends.

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.player: It was that or we try to kill them all, and I'm not totally sure wiping out a whole race would have been the best of ideas either... not that we'd have ever likely been able to.

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.npc: You make a good point. And I suppose the King is behind it, even if that advisor of his isn't... Even still, I'm glad we have the Salve to stop them if they do try anything.
In happier news, Ivan is now able to properly focus on his studying... though he does still sneak off for the odd adventure from time to time.

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.player: Well, I suppose you can't be too picky.

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.npc: Indeed. The important part is that he will be a worthy successor. Of that, I can be confident.

standard-dialogue-after-priest-in-peril-.player: I couldn't agree more. Until next time, Drezel.

treasure-trails-medium.npc: I need you to help me with this.

treasure-trails-medium.text: Drezel has given you a challenge scroll!

steps.text: Drezel has given you another clue scroll!
